title: More for looks than freshness.
text: More for looks than freshness.. Cute, small tins.  They don't really keep anything fresh, but they are adorable and have a vintage, fun look to them.  I put my bag of coffee in one, some sugar packets in another and in the last one, I put my packs of creamer.  I wouldn't expect this to actually keep anything fresh.  I would lean more to adding a nostalgia look to your kitchen with these cute canisters.
